baseline_swap.mechanism: byte injection of product/tests/** from the ref, restored from saved bytes after the baseline run

scope.root_scope_rule: EVERY number in this artifact is ROOT_SCOPED: it is a measurement at the checkout root named above and is not a claim about any other root, any other mount, or any other host. A test whose verdict depends on where the tree is mounted will invert here; the tripwire below exists to catch exactly that.

method.command_shape: python -m pytest product/tests/ -q -p no:cacheprovider <one --ignore per uncollectable module>
method.ignore_rationale: Modules that cannot be COLLECTED in this environment are excluded from BOTH runs identically. The list is computed by attempting collection, never hard-coded. Their status is UNMEASURED, not passed and not failed.
method.comparison: SET comparison: both differences and the intersection of the FAILED/ERROR test-ID sets, plus the counted run summary. A count is never offered where a set relation is required.

raw_pytest_logs.why: Both runs' full pytest output, written beside this artifact and pinned by sha256, so every count here can be re-parsed offline by product/test_accounting.py (or by hand) instead of being taken on trust. product/test_accounting.py consumes these two files directly; the two artifacts therefore describe the SAME two runs.

set_relation.method: SET comparison: both differences and the intersection of the FAILED/ERROR test-ID sets, plus the counted run summary. A count is never offered where a set relation is required.
